name: F.N.B. Corporation
summary: F.N.B. Corporation, a bank and financial holding company, provides a range of financial products and services primarily to consumers, corporations, governments, and small- to medium-sized businesses in the United States. The company operates through three segments: Community Banking, Wealth Management, and Insurance. The Community Banking segment offers commercial and consumer banking services, including small business banking, investment real estate financing, business credit, capital market, and capital market and equipment financing services.
